video_title: ‘HE’S GETTING EXPOSED’ 😳 Perk says Wemby is to blame for Spurs’ historic Game 4 collapse | NBA Today

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Victor Wembanyama on the Spurs' second-half collapse
quotes.excerpt: I think it's just execution, greediness, some sort. We clearly weren't the most hungry in the second half.
quotes.quote: I can't really explain it right now. I don't know. I think it's just execution, greediness, some sort. We clearly weren't the most hungry in the second half.

quotes.speaker: Mitch Johnson
quotes.summary_phrase: Mitch Johnson on the Spurs' offensive struggles in Game 4
quotes.excerpt: We got on our heels and missed some shots and you don't get as many free throws.
quotes.quote: We got on our heels and missed some shots and you don't get as many free throws and high percentage looks when you play on your heels like that.

quotes.speaker: Chiney Ogwumike
quotes.summary_phrase: Chiney Ogwumike and Kendrick Perkins on Jalen Brunson's late-game decision
quotes.excerpt: It was a miscommunication or at least the wrong strategy. It looked like a double was coming.

text_blocks.speaker: Chiney Ogwumike
text_blocks.text: In the last couple of seconds, it was a miscommunication or at least the wrong strategy. It looked like a double was coming. That makes you vulnerable for a lack of offensive rebound. Who's responsibility is the box out? You say I'm Shumperd, it's De'Aaron Fox.

text_blocks.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
text_blocks.text: De'Aaron Fox left his man. If this is a strategic trap, this is the worst trap that I've ever seen. You left open driving lanes, rebounding lanes, everything. If that's a trap, that's a very unaggressive trap.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Kendrick Perkins on the Spurs' defensive failure against Jalen Brunson
quotes.excerpt: When you got the defensive player, that is the defensive player of the year, all bets are off.
quotes.quote: When you got the defensive player, that is the defensive player of the year, all bets are off. It's one-on-one, mano-a-mano, David and Goliath. Throw the rock or you going to go home.

quotes.speaker: Chiney Ogwumike
quotes.summary_phrase: Chiney Ogwumike on why the Spurs' defensive trap failed
quotes.excerpt: Traps typically in those circumstances are based off of pick and roll, not just out of the blue.
quotes.quote: Traps typically in those circumstances are based off of pick and roll, not just out of the blue. Out of the blue, Jalen Brunson knew it was coming. All he had to do was shoot it right on time so that he gave his teammates a chance to get the rebound.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Kendrick Perkins on Jalen Brunson's dominance in the series
quotes.excerpt: The defensive player of the year in this series, one-on-one, has been getting exposed.
quotes.quote: The defensive player of the year in this series, one-on-one, has been getting exposed. The defensive player of the year last night in the second half got disrespected. Jalen Brunson in the second half called the defensive player of the year in 21 of the actions. They picked on him.

quotes.speaker: Chiney Ogwumike
quotes.summary_phrase: Chiney Ogwumike on the need for better load management
quotes.excerpt: If Victor Wembanyama is 7'5, gifted, out of this world, but he gets tired, you call timeouts.
quotes.quote: If Victor Wembanyama is 7'5, gifted, out of this world, but he gets tired, you call timeouts to let him catch his breath. He was not his best form because the play kept going and going.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Kendrick Perkins on the intensity of the NBA Finals
quotes.excerpt: The NBA Finals don't care about how tired you are. It's about making the most of the moments.
quotes.quote: The NBA Finals don't care about how tired you are. It's about making the most of the moments you're on the floor for.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Kendrick Perkins on the Spurs' defensive strategy against Karl-Anthony Towns
quotes.excerpt: Mitch Johnson said, I'm going to protect you, I'm going to put Josh Hart on you.
quotes.quote: Mitch Johnson said, I'm going to protect you, I'm going to put Josh Hart on you. Yeah, I'm going to hide you and let you be the wrong guy. And then all of a sudden Jalen Brunson said, so once again, we highlight Jalen Brunson for a reason.
